## Summary

```text
opening even frame: save current → blur H/V twice
closing even frame: overlay saved[index] → index--
```

Add the browser-independent pause bitmap model before connecting it to screen capture. This layer depends on #25.

## Evidence

- **Before:** no retained pixel/history model; the screen uses live CSS blur.
  **After:** tests protect save-before-blur ordering, the unused first reverse slot, 19 saved frames, exact opaque restoration and disposal. UI integration follows separately.
- Regenerated the authored 5799-byte AVM2 probe with its recorded SHA256 and reproduced all486 getPixel32 readings in Ruffle0.7.1/wgpu-webgl. The regression preserves two known mixed-RGB one-byte discrepancies; Adobe and full-game parity remain unproven.
- Decompiled source and exported pcode confirm ordering; pinned Ruffle source explains fractional weights and per-axis flooring. Source-tag identity versus installed WASM remains unverified.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 438 tests /5653 assertions and production build pass. This layer changes no browser flow. No SWF or original media is committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

The model is not connected to production UI in this layer; numerical approximation limits remain documented.

input.head: feat/settings-motion-model
input.title: feat: recover settings geometry and sequential row motion
input.body:
## Summary

```text
settings: Title → FPS → Quality → … → Back (updated y<200)
hotkeys: Title → … → Pause (updated y<400)
                           ├ Back
                           └ Locked
```

Add the settings/hotkey geometry importer and frame model before connecting the screen. Persistence, bindings and UI remain separate backlog changes.

## Evidence

- **Before:** no model of the authored staggered row motion.
  **After:** tests preserve quantized same-frame gates, retained exits and freeze behavior. At hotkey frame36, Pause reaches398.8 and Back/Locked independently move to543.85/539.35.
- Independent ActionScript/pcode audit confirms formulas, order and source-state mapping. The caller must freeze Info/closing and reset hotkey return state on new entry; this layer does not claim the complete state machine.
- Two repeatable imports match backlog data byte for byte (SHA2561d24479e701061f502ed1d136c9ef91725c6bfa2a08450e78b89205eb4bd6b77). Relevant root/frame placements agree with the shared parser; origins verified against pause placements and menu source.
- Formatting, TypeScript,444 tests /5705 assertions and production build pass. Visible browser flows are unchanged. No SWF, original images/audio or vector outlines are committed.
- Original settings recordings, final caller routing, text/filter pixels and complete-game parity remain unverified.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

Geometry contains numeric placements/bounds plus label and field/font metadata. Screen integration follows separately.

## Summary

```text
MainMenuMotion
  countdown → action delay → play glow → fade
import-main-menu → numeric placements / bounds / IDs
```

First split of the settings/main-menu backlog checkpoint. The model and geometry land before screen integration; this layer changes no visible browser flow.

## Evidence

- **Before:** no source frame model for the main menu.
  **After:** four rule checks preserve Run96 restoration, the31-call action delay and busy/back gates, quantized fades, floating glow overshoot and authored registrations.
- Independent ActionScript/pcode audit confirms recurrence/order for intended Settings/Credits flows. Root556 inherits the motion class; its title placement has identity alpha1. Caller routing, native drawing and original-runtime pixel comparison follow separately.
- Two repeatable imports produce identical SHA2561178dd26913920ac8e20a5e47329627700a25dbb4d959236734f7b31515854c3 and match the backlog data byte for byte. Geometry contains numerical metadata only.
- Formatting, TypeScript,442 tests /5684 assertions and production build pass. No SWF or original media is committed. Complete-game parity remains unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

Model is not connected to the UI in this layer. Retired control registrations do not restore network functionality.
